title: Kaspersky says DDoS attacks on Russian IT companies rose 61% in first half of 2026, relayed by RIA Novosti
date_note: Both pages (24 November) relay Kaspersky figures to RIA Novosti; the day Kaspersky gave them is not stated.
summary: PRIME and Vzglyad relay Kaspersky Lab data given to RIA Novosti. PRIME says the number of DDoS attacks on Russian IT companies rose by 61% in the first half of 2026 against the same period of 2025. Vzglyad words the same 61% as cyberattacks on the infrastructure of Russian IT companies, not DDoS specifically.
plain: Kaspersky says DDoS attacks on Russian IT companies rose by 61% in the first half of 2026 compared with a year earlier, as relayed by Russian media.
exec: Kaspersky's figures, as relayed by PRIME, show DDoS attacks on Russian IT companies up 61% in the first half of 2026.

evidence.quote: Количество DDoS-атак на российские IT-компании в 2026 году выросло на 61%.

validation.note: PRIME and Vzglyad both relay one Kaspersky statement to RIA Novosti, so they are one source; Vzglyad's lead says cyberattacks in general while PRIME says DDoS attacks. Kaspersky's own report was not read. CNews (read 24 November) also gives 61% for DDoS attacks on Russian IT companies in the first half of 2026 against the same period of 2025, citing Kaspersky DDoS Protection data; it stays single_source (Kaspersky).

review.note: sources disagree on scope: PRIME says DDoS, Vzglyad says cyberattacks; summary now says both
